correctness.rationale: The Leibniz derivation recursion is forced by D(e_1)=sum a_j e_j, giving diagonal (i a_1) and fixed upper-triangular bands. D^p=D implies a_1^p=a_1, hence a_1∈F_p; if a_1=0, D nilpotent and D=D^(p^j) forces zero. Otherwise the separable polynomial t^p−t yields a diagonalizable D and spectral projector I−(D−cI)^(p−1). Applied to e_1 it gives a c-eigenvector with first coefficient 1, whose iterated brackets form a generator basis. The resulting algebra automorphism conjugates D to cH. The quotient eigenvalue c is invariant. Automorphisms arise from generators with nonzero e_1 coefficient, and commuting generators have possible nonzero coefficients only in indices 1 mod p; this gives stabilizer (q−1)q^floor((n−1)/p) and orbit size q^(n−1−floor((n−1)/p)). Rank and odd-characteristic idempotent boundary follow from diagonal. Independently exhaustively enumerated all linear maps n=2,3,4 at q=2 and n=2,3 at q=3; these are corroborations, not infinite proof.
